roadmap.title: New Game — protect quests and complete first-cycle collections
roadmap.description: Keep Steam connected, raise Intelligence to 15, preserve every boss soul and Titanite material, discover the early covenants, protect spell merchants, cut every available tail, finish the base-game spell sets that do not require Gwyn's soul, clear the optional bosses, and take To Link the Fire only after all first-cycle cleanup is complete.

roadmap.title: New Game+ — Darkwraith route, reinforcement paths, and boss weapons
roadmap.description: Avoid Frampt, defeat Sif and the Four Kings early to join Darkwraith through Kaathe, recollect every Ember, build all ten maximum reinforcement paths, forge every available boss-soul weapon, and leave Gwyn's arena for The Dark Lord ending.

roadmap.title: New Game++ — Sunlight covenant and final boss-soul cleanup
roadmap.description: Meet the Warrior of Sunlight Faith requirement, obtain its three miracles, defeat Sif a third time, rush to the Giant Blacksmith for the final Artorias weapon, and confirm every other achievement before Knight's Honor completes the set.

achievements.sortReason: Final meta unlock after every other achievement.
achievements.summary: Unlock all other 40 DARK SOULS: REMASTERED Steam achievements on the same profile.

guide.context: This meta achievement is expected to appear with the final remaining unlock; keep the Steam client connected because offline unlock events may not be backfilled.

steps.text: Confirm that every non-meta achievement is unlocked in Steam; The Dark Soul should trigger with the last one.

achievements.sortReason: First-cycle ending after all NG cleanup.
achievements.summary: Inside the @loc{Kiln of the First Flame}, defeat @enemy{Gwyn, Lord of Cinder} and light the bonfire for the To Link the Fire ending.

guide.context: Touching the bonfire immediately ends the current cycle, so finish first-cycle spell, covenant, tail-cut, and optional-boss cleanup before defeating Gwyn.

steps.text: Inside the @loc{Kiln of the First Flame}, win the battle against @enemy{Gwyn, Lord of Cinder}.
Interact with the central bonfire and choose to light it; the To Link the Fire ending begins and starts the next cycle.

achievements.sortReason: Alternate ending at the end of NG+.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Gwyn, Lord of Cinder}, then leave the @loc{Kiln of the First Flame} without touching the bonfire for The Dark Lord ending.

guide.context: The central bonfire selects the opposite ending; this route is reserved for NG+ after the Darkwraith and reinforcement work is complete.

steps.text: Inside the @loc{Kiln of the First Flame}, win the battle against @enemy{Gwyn, Lord of Cinder}.
Turn away from the untouched bonfire and walk out through the arena entrance to start The Dark Lord ending.

achievements.sortReason: Requires the third Soul of Sif in NG++.
achievements.summary: Acquire every weapon on the conservative 50-entry rare-weapon checklist on one character, covering boss-soul ascensions, tail cuts, fixed finds, covenants, and enemy drops.

guide.context: Three separate @item{Soul of Sif} copies force progress into NG++; all weapons must remain credited to one character, and DLC weapons are excluded. The list conservatively includes Gargoyle Tail Axe, Demon's Catalyst, and Izalith Catalyst.

collectibles.name: Moonlight Butterfly Horn
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 rapier or spear with 1 @item{Soul of the Moonlight Butterfly}.

collectibles.name: Crystal Ring Shield
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 shield with a second @item{Soul of the Moonlight Butterfly}.

collectibles.name: Quelaag's Furysword
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 curved sword with 1 @item{Soul of Quelaag}.

collectibles.name: Chaos Blade
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 katana with a second @item{Soul of Quelaag}.

collectibles.name: Golem Axe
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 axe with 1 @item{Core of an Iron Golem}.

collectibles.name: Dragon Bone Fist
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a +10 @item{Caestus} with a second @item{Core of an Iron Golem}.

collectibles.name: Smough's Hammer
collectibles.method: Kill Ornstein first so empowered Smough drops the @item{Soul of Smough}, then ascend a compatible +10 hammer at the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}.

collectibles.name: Dragonslayer Spear
collectibles.method: Kill Smough first so empowered Ornstein drops the @item{Soul of Ornstein}, then ascend a compatible +10 spear or rapier at the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}.

collectibles.name: Darkmoon Bow
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 bow with 1 @item{Soul of Gwyndolin}.

collectibles.name: Tin Darkmoon Catalyst
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend any catalyst with a second @item{Soul of Gwyndolin}; no +10 reinforcement is required.

collectibles.name: Lifehunt Scythe
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 scythe or halberd with the @item{Soul of Priscilla}.

collectibles.name: Great Lord Greatsword
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 sword with 1 @item{Soul of Gwyn}.
collectibles.note: Reserve another Gwyn soul for the Sunlight Spear miracle in a later cycle.

collectibles.name: Greatsword of Artorias (True)
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a +10 @item{Broken Straight Sword} or @item{Straight Sword Hilt} with 1 @item{Soul of Sif}.

collectibles.name: Greatsword of Artorias (Cursed)
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 sword with a second @item{Soul of Sif}.

collectibles.name: Greatshield of Artorias
collectibles.method: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, ascend a compatible +10 shield with the third @item{Soul of Sif} in NG++.

collectibles.name: Drake Sword
collectibles.method: From beneath the bridge, repeatedly shoot the @enemy{Hellkite Wyvern}'s tail until the tail breaks and awards the weapon.

collectibles.name: Gargoyle Tail Axe
collectibles.method: Cut a @enemy{Bell Gargoyle}'s tail before killing the available gargoyles.

collectibles.name: Dragon King Greataxe
collectibles.method: Attack the outer portion of the @enemy{Gaping Dragon}'s tail until the tail breaks before the boss dies.

collectibles.name: Dragon Greatsword
collectibles.method: Walk behind the non-hostile @npc{Stone Dragon} and cut its tail; the covenant leader does not become hostile.

collectibles.name: Priscilla's Dagger
collectibles.method: Cut @enemy{Crossbreed Priscilla}'s small tail before killing her; leave the attempt if her health becomes too low.

collectibles.name: Moonlight Greatsword
collectibles.method: Destroy Seath's @item{Primordial Crystal}, then strike the tip of the boss's rear tail until it breaks before Seath dies.

collectibles.name: Astora's Straight Sword
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse beside the @enemy{Undead Dragon}'s head.

collectibles.name: Dragon Crest Shield
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse beside the @enemy{Undead Dragon}'s right hand.

collectibles.name: Black Iron Greatshield
collectibles.method: Loot the guarded corpse in the far-left corner of the cathedral floor.

collectibles.name: Dragon Tooth
collectibles.method: Open the first chest along the hidden Havel-room wall.

collectibles.name: Havel's Greatshield
collectibles.method: Open the chest immediately beside the @item{Dragon Tooth} chest in the hidden Havel room.

collectibles.name: Dragonslayer Greatbow
collectibles.method: Exit through the broken stained-glass window above the palace entrance, descend the exterior ledges, and loot the hanging corpse.

collectibles.name: Velka's Rapier
collectibles.method: Use the @item{Annex Key}, break the wooden door on the upper landing, cross the bridge, and loot the corpse.

collectibles.name: Bloodshield
collectibles.method: Kill the bridge's @enemy{Undead Dragon} and loot the rear corpse that the dragon guarded.

collectibles.name: Effigy Shield
collectibles.method: Below the Black Knight, take the first cave exit on the right and follow the narrow cliff path to the isolated corpse.

collectibles.name: Crest Shield
collectibles.method: Return to the asylum and kill hollowed @npc{Oscar of Astora} outside his former room.

collectibles.name: Stone Greatsword
collectibles.method: Farm @enemy{Great Stone Knights}, or join Forest Hunter and buy the weapon from @npc{Shiva of the East} in Blighttown for 15,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Stone Greatshield
collectibles.method: Farm the @enemy{Great Stone Knights} in the grove beyond the side path.

collectibles.name: Giant's Halberd
collectibles.method: Buy the weapon from the @npc{Giant Blacksmith} for 5,000 souls, or obtain it from a Sentinel drop.

collectibles.name: Silver Knight Straight Sword
collectibles.method: Farm sword-wielding @enemy{Silver Knights} near the palace bonfire.

collectibles.name: Silver Knight Spear
collectibles.method: Farm spear-wielding @enemy{Silver Knights} near the palace bonfire.

collectibles.name: Silver Knight Shield
collectibles.method: Farm any @enemy{Silver Knight} near the palace bonfire.

collectibles.name: Channeler's Trident
collectibles.method: Farm the two respawning @enemy{Channelers} in the upper library until the trident drops.

collectibles.name: Demon's Catalyst
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{Demon Firesage} and pick up the catalyst drop.

collectibles.name: Izalith Catalyst
collectibles.method: Kill the hostile @enemy{Daughter of Chaos} pyromancer and collect the catalyst.

collectibles.name: Grant
collectibles.method: While human and before Nito dies, trigger @enemy{Paladin Leeroy}'s invasion and kill him away from the cliff edge.

collectibles.name: Sanctus
collectibles.method: Collect the shield dropped with Grant after killing invading @enemy{Paladin Leeroy} before Nito dies.

collectibles.name: Crescent Axe
collectibles.method: After sparing @npc{Patches} in Tomb of Giants, buy the axe from his Firelink shop for 10,000 souls; killing him also drops it.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Shield
collectibles.method: Farm the five respawning @enemy{Black Knights}; any of them can drop the shield.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Sword
collectibles.method: Farm the respawning sword-wielding @enemy{Black Knights}.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Greatsword
collectibles.method: Farm the respawning greatsword-wielding @enemy{Black Knight}.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Halberd
collectibles.method: Farm the respawning halberd-wielding @enemy{Black Knight}.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Greataxe
collectibles.method: Farm the respawning greataxe-wielding @enemy{Black Knight}.

collectibles.name: Gravelord Sword
collectibles.method: Join @npc{Gravelord Nito}'s covenant before killing him and receive the rank-0 joining gift.

collectibles.name: Dark Hand
collectibles.method: Join @npc{Darkstalker Kaathe}'s covenant for the rank-0 gift, or farm @enemy{Darkwraiths} for the rare drop.

achievements.estTime: 3–5 hours of quest and purchase work
achievements.summary: Acquire all 24 base-game sorceries on one character, including every required merchant purchase, fixed pickup, and quest reward.

guide.context: @npc{Griggs of Vinheim} requires 10 Intelligence and @npc{Big Hat Logan} requires 15. Buy Dusk's five spells before placing the Lordvessel if the DLC route will be skipped.

collectibles.name: Cast Light
collectibles.method: Buy the sorcery from @npc{Dusk of Oolacile} for 1,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Hidden Weapon
collectibles.method: Buy the sorcery from @npc{Dusk of Oolacile} for 2,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Hidden Body
collectibles.method: Buy the sorcery from @npc{Dusk of Oolacile} for 2,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Great Heavy Soul Arrow

collectibles.name: Magic Weapon
collectibles.method: Buy the sorcery from @npc{Big Hat Logan} for 3,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Magic Shield
collectibles.method: Buy the sorcery from @npc{Big Hat Logan} for 3,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Homing Soulmass

collectibles.name: Soul Spear
collectibles.method: Pay 40,000 souls at @npc{Big Hat Logan}'s shop to obtain the sorcery.

collectibles.name: Remedy
collectibles.method: Climb the turning-wheel route to upper Blighttown and open the chest beside the dead-end corpse.

collectibles.name: Hush
collectibles.method: Drop from the boulder stairs to the Manserpent Mage platform, enter the passage beneath the stairs, and loot the corpse beyond the iron grate.

collectibles.name: Great Magic Weapon

collectibles.name: Strong Magic Shield
collectibles.method: Rotate the library stairs, reach the floor occupied by the second @enemy{Channeler}, and open the chest at that floor's right end.

collectibles.name: Crystal Magic Weapon
collectibles.method: Free @npc{Big Hat Logan} from prison, find his library shop, and pay 20,000 souls for the sorcery.

collectibles.name: Homing Crystal Soulmass
collectibles.method: Free @npc{Big Hat Logan} from the prison, meet him in the library, and buy the sorcery for 30,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Crystal Soul Spear
collectibles.method: Free @npc{Big Hat Logan} from the prison, meet him in the library, and buy the sorcery for 50,000 souls.

collectibles.name: White Dragon Breath
collectibles.method: Buy Logan's required inventories, defeat Seath, find hollow @npc{Big Hat Logan} in Seath's original study, and kill him for the drop.

collectibles.name: Resist Curse
collectibles.method: After draining New Londo, buy the sorcery from @npc{Ingward} for 5,000 souls.

achievements.estTime: 3–5 hours of quest and purchase work
achievements.summary: Acquire all 19 base-game pyromancies on one character, including Quelana's inventory and both Chaos Servant rank rewards.

guide.context: @npc{Quelana of Izalith} must appear before Bed of Chaos dies; bring a +10 Pyromancy Flame into Blighttown, buy her stock, and accept her request before the boss kill.

collectibles.name: Iron Flesh
collectibles.method: Rescue @npc{Laurentius of the Great Swamp} and buy the pyromancy for 2,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Flash Sweat
collectibles.method: Rescue @npc{Laurentius of the Great Swamp} and buy the pyromancy for 2,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Fireball
collectibles.method: Spend 800 souls at @npc{Quelana of Izalith}'s shop for the pyromancy; Pyromancers begin with it.

collectibles.name: Fire Orb
collectibles.method: Buy the pyromancy from @npc{Quelana of Izalith} for 8,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Combustion
collectibles.method: Spend 500 souls at @npc{Quelana of Izalith}'s shop for the pyromancy.

collectibles.name: Power Within
collectibles.method: Reach the rear of the @enemy{Parasitic Wall Hugger}, kill it from behind, and loot the corpse on the platform below.

collectibles.name: Poison Mist
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse against the wall left of the large stone bridge support, or buy the pyromancy from @npc{Eingyi}.

collectibles.name: Toxic Mist
collectibles.method: Become infected with an egg parasite, speak to @npc{Eingyi}, and buy the pyromancy for 25,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Great Fireball
collectibles.method: Spend 20,000 souls at @npc{Quelana of Izalith}'s shop for the pyromancy.

collectibles.name: Firestorm
collectibles.method: Spend 30,000 souls at @npc{Quelana of Izalith}'s shop for the pyromancy.

collectibles.name: Fire Whip
collectibles.method: Spend 10,000 souls at @npc{Quelana of Izalith}'s shop for the pyromancy.

collectibles.name: Great Combustion
collectibles.method: Buy the pyromancy from @npc{Quelana of Izalith} for 5,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Undead Rapport
collectibles.method: Spend 10,000 souls at @npc{Quelana of Izalith}'s shop for the pyromancy.

collectibles.name: Fire Surge
collectibles.method: Kill the Engorged Zombie in the well tunnels that drops the pyromancy.

collectibles.name: Acid Surge
collectibles.method: After opening the courtyard shortcut, follow the snowy impaled-hollow outcrop around the small wall and loot the corpse.

collectibles.name: Chaos Fire Whip
collectibles.method: Beyond the hostile Daughter of Chaos, kill the nearby @enemy{Chaos Eater} and open the chest behind it.

collectibles.name: Fire Tempest
collectibles.method: Buy Quelana's stock, accept her request, defeat @enemy{Bed of Chaos}, and return to @npc{Quelana of Izalith} for the reward.

collectibles.name: Great Chaos Fireball
collectibles.method: Join @npc{The Fair Lady}'s covenant and receive the rank-0 gift.

collectibles.name: Chaos Storm
collectibles.method: Give @npc{The Fair Lady} 30 soft Humanity, raising Chaos Servant to rank +2 and awarding the pyromancy.

achievements.estTime: 5–8 hours of covenant and quest work
achievements.summary: Acquire all 23 base-game miracles on one character, including every required covenant-rank reward and the Soul of Gwyn exchange.

guide.context: No multiplayer is required, but the covenant offerings can be lengthy offline. Obtain Darkmoon Blade before fighting Gwyndolin, join Gravelord Servant before killing Nito, and reserve a Gwyn soul for Sunlight Spear.

collectibles.name: Heal
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Reah of Thorolund}, buy the miracle from her for 1,000 souls; Clerics begin with it.

collectibles.name: Great Heal Excerpt
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Reah of Thorolund}, buy the miracle from her for 2,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Homeward
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Reah of Thorolund}, buy the miracle from her for 1,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Force
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Reah of Thorolund}, buy the miracle from her for 1,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Karmic Justice
collectibles.method: Buy the miracle from @npc{Oswald of Carim} for 40,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Great Magic Barrier
collectibles.method: Before the windy beach path, climb the twisted root, drop into the hollow branch, and loot the corpse above the mushrooms.

collectibles.name: Tranquil Walk of Peace
collectibles.method: Enter the broken wall beside the giant-skeleton room, climb the ladder marked by the Up message, and loot the corpse beyond the statue trap.

collectibles.name: Vow of Silence
collectibles.method: Use the @item{Annex Key}, climb to the upper landing, kill the Crow Demons, and loot the corpse.

collectibles.name: Soothing Sunlight
collectibles.method: At the prison tower's bottom, kill the non-hostile @enemy{Pisaca} closest to the rear wall.

collectibles.name: Bountiful Sunlight
collectibles.method: At the prison tower's bottom, kill the second non-hostile @enemy{Pisaca}, farther from the rear wall.

collectibles.name: Darkmoon Blade
collectibles.method: Offer 10 @item{Souvenirs of Reprisal} to @npc{Dark Sun Gwyndolin} to reach covenant rank +1 before entering the fog gate.

collectibles.name: Sunlight Blade
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{Dark Sun Gwyndolin} after obtaining Darkmoon Blade, then open the chest before Gwyn's tomb.

collectibles.name: Replenishment
collectibles.method: Rescue @npc{Reah of Thorolund} from the pit and receive the miracle as her reward.

collectibles.name: Great Heal
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Reah of Thorolund}, buy the miracle from her for 10,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Wrath of the Gods
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Reah of Thorolund}, buy the miracle from her for 10,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Seek Guidance
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Reah of Thorolund}, buy the miracle from her for 500 souls.

collectibles.name: Magic Barrier
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Reah of Thorolund}, buy the miracle from her for 6,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Emit Force
collectibles.method: Help @npc{Siegmeyer of Catarina} in Anor Londo, then speak to him at Firelink Shrine for the reward.

collectibles.name: Gravelord Sword Dance
collectibles.method: Join @npc{Gravelord Nito}'s covenant before killing him and receive the rank-0 gift.

collectibles.name: Gravelord Greatsword Dance
collectibles.method: Offer 10 @item{Eyes of Death} to @npc{Gravelord Nito} to reach covenant rank +1 before killing him.

collectibles.name: Lightning Spear
collectibles.method: Meet the Faith requirement, join at the @loc{Sunlight Altar}, and receive the rank-0 gift.

collectibles.name: Great Lightning Spear
collectibles.method: Offer 10 @item{Sunlight Medals} at the @loc{Sunlight Altar} to reach covenant rank +1.

collectibles.name: Sunlight Spear
collectibles.method: While Warrior of Sunlight rank +1, offer 1 @item{Soul of Gwyn} at the altar and receive the miracle.

achievements.summary: Exhaust @npc{Petrus of Thorolund}'s dialogue at @loc{Firelink Shrine} until the Way of White joining prompt appears, then accept the covenant.

guide.context: Clerics start in Way of White, but Steam credit still requires discovering the covenant through Petrus's dialogue prompt.

steps.text: From the Firelink bonfire, enter the upper ruins and speak repeatedly with @npc{Petrus of Thorolund} until he gives the Copper Coin.
Speak to Petrus again and select Yes when he offers the @mechanic{Way of White} covenant.

achievements.summary: In @loc{Anor Londo}, claim the @item{Lordvessel} from @npc{Gwynevere}, speak to her again, and accept the Princess's Guard covenant.

guide.context: The joining offer appears only after Ornstein and Smough are defeated and Gwynevere has handed over the Lordvessel.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Ornstein and Smough}, ride the elevator above their arena, and speak to @npc{Gwynevere} to receive the @item{Lordvessel}.
Speak to Gwynevere again and select Enter Covenant at the @mechanic{Princess's Guard} prompt.

achievements.description: Discover Blade of the Darkmoon covenant.
achievements.summary: Equip the @item{Darkmoon Seance Ring} at @loc{Darkmoon Tomb}, descend behind Gwyn's vanished statue, kneel before @npc{Dark Sun Gwyndolin}, and accept Blade of the Darkmoon.

guide.context: Entering Gwyndolin's fog gate breaks covenant access for the cycle, so earn the Darkmoon Blade miracle with 10 Souvenirs of Reprisal before starting the boss fight.

steps.text: Loot the @item{Darkmoon Seance Ring} from the open sarcophagus beyond the giant-skeleton room in @loc{The Catacombs}.
Equip the ring at the @loc{Darkmoon Tomb} bonfire and approach Gwyn's statue to reveal the stairs.
Descend, kneel between the four candles when @npc{Dark Sun Gwyndolin} speaks, and select Enter Covenant.

achievements.estTime: 5 min after meeting the Faith requirement
achievements.summary: Meet the 25 Faith requirement, pray at the @loc{Sunlight Altar} beside the Hellkite gatehouse bonfire, and accept the Warrior of Sunlight covenant.

guide.context: Each successful co-op boss victory lowers the Faith requirement by 5, but multiplayer is optional and 25 base Faith satisfies the altar directly.

steps.text: Cross the @loc{Undead Burg} bridge guarded by the @enemy{Hellkite Wyvern} and enter the gatehouse beside the bonfire.
With the Faith requirement met, pray at the balcony's @loc{Sunlight Altar} and select Join Covenant.

achievements.summary: Open the sealed @loc{Darkroot Garden} door with the @item{Crest of Artorias}, find @npc{Alvina}, and answer Yes to both Forest Hunter questions.

guide.context: The forest NPCs become neutral after joining; selecting in-game offline mode avoids player invasions without taking the Steam client offline.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Crest of Artorias} from @npc{Andre of Astora} and use it on the sealed door beside the Darkroot bonfire.
Cross the forest near the left cliff edge and enter the stone building before the bridge.
Speak to @npc{Alvina}, answer Yes to both questions, and accept the @mechanic{Forest Hunter} covenant.

achievements.summary: Do not let @npc{Kingseeker Frampt} place the @item{Lordvessel}; defeat the @enemy{Four Kings}, answer Yes to @npc{Darkstalker Kaathe}, place the vessel through Kaathe, and accept the Darkwraith covenant.

guide.context: Placing the Lordvessel through Frampt removes Kaathe from that cycle; answering No to Kaathe also makes him leave permanently until the next cycle.

steps.text: After receiving the @item{Lordvessel}, do not let @npc{Kingseeker Frampt} place it.
Defeat @enemy{Great Grey Wolf Sif}, equip the @item{Covenant of Artorias}, drain @loc{New Londo Ruins}, and defeat the @enemy{Four Kings}.
Speak to @npc{Darkstalker Kaathe} in the Abyss and answer Yes when he asks for an Age of Dark.
Let Kaathe take you to @loc{Firelink Altar}, place the Lordvessel, return to the Abyss, speak to him again, and select Join Covenant.

achievements.description: Discover Path of the Dragon covenant.
achievements.summary: Descend through @loc{The Great Hollow} to @loc{Ash Lake}, pray to the @npc{Stone Dragon} at the far end, and accept the Path of the Dragon covenant.

guide.context: The Lordvessel makes the return trip painless because the Stone Dragon bonfire is warpable; the covenant leader remains friendly after its tail is cut.

steps.text: In @loc{Blighttown swamp}, enter the giant hollow tree and break both illusory walls to reveal @loc{The Great Hollow}.
Descend the tree, cross @loc{Ash Lake}, and follow the beach to the @npc{Stone Dragon}.
Pray to the Stone Dragon and select Enter Covenant.

achievements.summary: While @npc{Gravelord Nito} is alive, carry an @item{Eye of Death} to the Catacombs crypt behind the Titanite Demon, nestle in the protruding coffin, pray to Nito, and accept Gravelord Servant.

guide.context: Nito must still be alive. Collect the covenant's two miracles and Gravelord Sword before entering his boss fight later in the route.

steps.text: Collect the three @item{Eyes of Death} from the corpse behind the @enemy{Titanite Demon} in @loc{The Catacombs}.
Follow the right wall five coffins from that corpse, choose Nestle in Coffin at the protruding open sarcophagus, and wait for transport.
Exit the coffin in Nito's chamber, pray at his sarcophagus, and select Enter Covenant.

achievements.summary: After ringing Quelaag's bell, strike the partially uncovered illusory wall in the lower bell-tower room beneath it, answer Yes to @npc{Eingyi}, and accept the Chaos Servant covenant from @npc{The Fair Lady}.

guide.context: The Fair Lady supplies Great Chaos Fireball on joining and Chaos Storm after 30 Humanity; neither covenant reward requires multiplayer.

steps.text: Descend below the second Bell of Awakening and strike the wall on the room's right side where the Blightpus does not fully cover the surface.
Enter the hidden passage and answer Yes when @npc{Eingyi} asks whether you are a new servant.
Speak to @npc{The Fair Lady} beside the bonfire and select Enter Covenant.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through standard reinforcement.
achievements.summary: Give both standard-path Embers to @npc{Andre of Astora}; a +15 weapon costs 9 Titanite Shards, 9 Large Titanite Shards, 7 Titanite Chunks, and finally 1 Titanite Slab.

guide.context: The two Embers are lost when a new cycle begins, so complete the path before ending the current cycle.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Large Ember} from the chest left of the Undead Butcher's cutting table in @loc{The Depths} kitchen, and collect the @item{Very Large Ember} from the third-floor chest in the first lower @loc{New Londo Ruins} structure after draining the water; give both to @npc{Andre of Astora}.
Use 9 @item{Titanite Shards} to reach Standard +5, then ascend and use 9 @item{Large Titanite Shards} to reach +10.
Use 7 @item{Titanite Chunks} to reach +14, then 1 @item{Titanite Slab} to reach Standard +15.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through crystal reinforcement.
achievements.summary: Give the @item{Crystal Ember} to the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, then spend 8 Titanite Chunks and 1 Titanite Slab to turn a +10 standard weapon into Crystal +5.

guide.context: The fixed @item{Crystal Halberd} can be reinforced instead to skip the standard +10 preparation.

steps.text: Give the @item{Crystal Ember} from @loc{The Duke's Archives} to the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}.
Spend 1 @item{Titanite Chunk} to ascend a +10 standard weapon to Crystal +0, or use the fixed @item{Crystal Halberd}.
From Crystal +0, use 7 @item{Titanite Chunks} for Crystal +4 and 1 @item{Titanite Slab} for Crystal +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through lightning reinforcement.
achievements.summary: At the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, spend 8 Titanite Chunks and 1 Titanite Slab to turn a +10 standard weapon into Lightning +5.

guide.context: The @item{Lightning Spear} mimic drop in Sen's Fortress can be reinforced directly and skips the standard +10 preparation.

steps.text: Bring a +10 standard weapon to the @npc{Giant Blacksmith}, or retain the @item{Lightning Spear} from @loc{Sen's Fortress}.
Spend 1 @item{Titanite Chunk} to ascend the +10 weapon to Lightning +0 when needed.
From Lightning +0, use 7 @item{Titanite Chunks} for Lightning +4 and 1 @item{Titanite Slab} for Lightning +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through raw reinforcement.
achievements.summary: Hand @npc{Andre of Astora} the @item{Large Ember}; converting a +5 standard weapon and raising it to Raw +5 consumes 10 Large Titanite Shards.

guide.context: Raw ends at +5 and needs no slab, making this the cheapest special reinforcement achievement.

steps.text: Give @npc{Andre of Astora} the @item{Large Ember} from @loc{The Depths}.
Use 9 @item{Titanite Shards} to reinforce any standard weapon to +5, then choose Raw Ascension.
Use 10 @item{Large Titanite Shards} to reach Raw +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through magic reinforcement.
achievements.summary: Raise a weapon to Magic +5 at @npc{Rickert of Vinheim}, hand over the @item{Large Magic Ember}, spend 7 Blue Titanite Chunks, and finish Magic +10 with 1 Blue Titanite Slab.

guide.context: Reverting the fixed @item{Enchanted Falchion} to Magic +5 skips the standard, green-shard, and initial ascension tiers.

steps.text: Give the @item{Large Magic Ember} from @loc{The Duke's Archives} to @npc{Rickert of Vinheim}.
Ascend a +5 standard weapon to Magic +0 and spend 10 @item{Green Titanite Shards} for Magic +5, or revert an @item{Enchanted Falchion}.
Use 7 @item{Blue Titanite Chunks} for Magic +9 and 1 @item{Blue Titanite Slab} for Magic +10.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through enchanted reinforcement.
achievements.summary: At @npc{Rickert of Vinheim}, hand over the @item{Enchanted Ember}; converting Magic +5 into Enchanted +5 costs 8 Blue Titanite Chunks and finally 1 Blue Titanite Slab.

guide.context: The fixed @item{Enchanted Falchion} from the Duke's Archives mimic skips the standard and Magic preparation tiers.

steps.text: Give the @item{Enchanted Ember} from @loc{Darkroot Garden} to @npc{Rickert of Vinheim}.
Convert Magic +5 into Enchanted +0 for 1 @item{Blue Titanite Chunk}, or begin with the fixed @item{Enchanted Falchion}.
From Enchanted +0, use 7 @item{Blue Titanite Chunks} for Enchanted +4 and 1 @item{Blue Titanite Slab} for Enchanted +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through divine reinforcement.
achievements.summary: Hand both Divine-path Embers to @npc{Andre of Astora}; Divine +10 costs 10 Green Titanite Shards, followed by 7 White Titanite Chunks and finally 1 White Titanite Slab.

guide.context: Reverting an @item{Occult Club} to Divine +5 skips the standard, green-shard, and initial ascension tiers.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Divine Ember} from the petrified blacksmith beyond the @enemy{Moonlight Butterfly} bridge, and collect the @item{Large Divine Ember} from the petrified blacksmith in the giant-skeleton crypt near the @loc{Tomb of the Giants} bonfire; give both to @npc{Andre of Astora}.
Ascend a +5 standard weapon and spend 10 @item{Green Titanite Shards} for Divine +5, or revert an @item{Occult Club}.
Use 7 @item{White Titanite Chunks} for Divine +9 and 1 @item{White Titanite Slab} for Divine +10.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through occult reinforcement.
achievements.summary: At @npc{Andre of Astora}, supply the Divine and Dark Embers; converting Divine +5 into Occult +5 costs 8 White Titanite Chunks and finally 1 White Titanite Slab.

guide.context: The fixed @item{Occult Club} from the Anor Londo mimic skips the standard and Divine preparation tiers.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Divine Ember} from the petrified blacksmith beyond the @enemy{Moonlight Butterfly} bridge, and collect the @item{Dark Ember} from the petrified blacksmith in the @loc{Painted World of Ariamis} annex reached with the @item{Annex Key}; give both to @npc{Andre of Astora}.
Convert Divine +5 into Occult +0 for 1 @item{White Titanite Chunk}, or begin with the fixed @item{Occult Club}.
From Occult +0, use 7 @item{White Titanite Chunks} for Occult +4 and 1 @item{White Titanite Slab} for Occult +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through fire reinforcement.
achievements.summary: At @npc{Blacksmith Vamos}, use the @item{Large Flame Ember}, 10 Green Titanite Shards, 7 Red Titanite Chunks, and 1 Red Titanite Slab to turn a +5 standard weapon into Fire +10.

guide.context: Only one guaranteed base-game Red Titanite Slab is available per cycle, so the route collects a second slab in NG+ for the separate Chaos path.

steps.text: From the Demon Ruins' Capra Garrison bonfire, take the left path before the @enemy{Demon Firesage}, pass two Taurus Demons, and loot the @item{Large Flame Ember} from the chest beyond the Burrowing Rockworms; give it to @npc{Blacksmith Vamos} in @loc{The Catacombs}.
Spend 1 @item{Green Titanite Shard} to ascend a +5 standard weapon to Fire +0, then use 9 more Green Titanite Shards for Fire +5.
Use 7 @item{Red Titanite Chunks} for Fire +9 and 1 @item{Red Titanite Slab} for Fire +10.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through chaos reinforcement.
achievements.summary: Give the @item{Chaos Flame Ember} to @npc{Blacksmith Vamos}, then spend 8 Red Titanite Chunks and 1 Red Titanite Slab to turn a Fire +5 weapon into Chaos +5.

guide.context: Chaos branches from Fire +5, and its slab cannot be shared with the separate Fire +10 achievement.

steps.text: Give the @item{Chaos Flame Ember} from @loc{Demon Ruins} to @npc{Blacksmith Vamos}.
Spend 1 @item{Red Titanite Chunk} to ascend a Fire +5 weapon to Chaos +0.
From Chaos +0, use 7 @item{Red Titanite Chunks} for Chaos +4 and 1 @item{Red Titanite Slab} for Chaos +5.

achievements.summary: Light the first bonfire in @loc{Northern Undead Asylum}.

guide.context: The achievement is an early tutorial unlock; resting is optional once the flame has been lit.

steps.text: Approach the first bonfire in @loc{Northern Undead Asylum} and select Light Bonfire.

achievements.summary: Speak to the wounded @npc{Oscar of Astora} in @loc{Northern Undead Asylum}, answer Yes, and receive the @item{Estus Flask}.

guide.context: The iron ball on the upper stairs breaks the wall that exposes Oscar's room during the mandatory asylum route.

steps.text: Climb the asylum stairs and let the rolling iron ball smash the wall behind you.
Enter the opening, speak to the wounded @npc{Oscar of Astora}, answer Yes, and accept the @item{Estus Flask}.

achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Asylum Demon}, leave @loc{Northern Undead Asylum}, and let the giant crow carry you to @loc{Firelink Shrine}.

guide.context: The achievement appears on arrival in Lordran after the tutorial, not when the asylum exit door opens.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Asylum Demon}, use the @item{Big Pilgrim's Key}, and leave the asylum through the large doors.
Walk to the cliff overlook and wait for the giant crow to carry you to @loc{Firelink Shrine}.

achievements.description: Ring Bell of Awakening at Undead Church.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Bell Gargoyles}, climb the @loc{Undead Parish} bell tower, and pull the lever to ring the first Bell of Awakening.

guide.context: Cut a Bell Gargoyle tail before ending the fight to secure the missable Gargoyle Tail Axe for Knight's Honor.

steps.text: Reach the church roof in @loc{Undead Parish} and defeat the @enemy{Bell Gargoyles}.
Enter the tower beyond the roof, climb to the top, and pull the lever beside the bell.

achievements.description: Ring Bell of Awakening in Quelaag's domain.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Chaos Witch Quelaag}, climb the tower beyond her arena, and pull the lever to ring the second Bell of Awakening.

guide.context: Ringing both bells opens Sen's Fortress; the hidden Chaos Servant room sits one floor below this bell.

steps.text: Cross @loc{Blighttown swamp}, enter @loc{Quelaag's Domain}, and defeat @enemy{Chaos Witch Quelaag}.
Cross the boss arena, climb the bell tower, and pull the lever beside the second Bell of Awakening.

achievements.summary: Reach the bottom of @loc{The Catacombs} and defeat @enemy{Pinwheel} to receive the @item{Rite of Kindling}.

guide.context: The rite allows each eligible bonfire to be kindled beyond 10 Estus uses, up to a maximum of 20 for the current cycle.

steps.text: Descend through @loc{The Catacombs} to the Bonewheel cavern and enter @enemy{Pinwheel}'s fog gate.
Defeat Pinwheel and receive the @item{Rite of Kindling} automatically.

achievements.summary: Open the sealed @loc{Darkroot Garden} route with the @item{Crest of Artorias}, defeat @enemy{Great Grey Wolf Sif}, and receive the @item{Covenant of Artorias}.

guide.context: The ring must remain equipped while entering and fighting in the Abyss; removing it there causes immediate death.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Crest of Artorias} from @npc{Andre of Astora} and use it on the sealed Darkroot door.
Cross the forest, enter Sif's grave, and defeat @enemy{Great Grey Wolf Sif} for the @item{Covenant of Artorias}.

achievements.summary: Ring both Bells of Awakening, defeat the @enemy{Iron Golem} atop @loc{Sen's Fortress}, and let the Bat Wing Demons carry you to @loc{Anor Londo}.

guide.context: The transport activates from the glowing ring beyond the Iron Golem arena; no manual travel connection to Anor Londo is required.

steps.text: Ring the bells in @loc{Undead Parish} and @loc{Quelaag's Domain} to open @loc{Sen's Fortress}.
Clear the fortress and defeat the @enemy{Iron Golem} on the rooftop.
Approach the glowing ring beyond the arena and accept transport from the Bat Wing Demons.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Ornstein and Smough} in @loc{Anor Londo}, ride the elevator above their arena, and receive the @item{Lordvessel} from @npc{Gwynevere}.

guide.context: The order in which the pair dies determines which boss soul is awarded; use the next cycle to obtain the other soul for Knight's Honor.

steps.text: Enter the Anor Londo cathedral and defeat @enemy{Ornstein and Smough}.
Ride the elevator above the arena, enter @npc{Gwynevere}'s chamber, and speak to her to receive the @item{Lordvessel}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Soul Lord Gravelord Nito.
achievements.summary: After placing the @item{Lordvessel}, traverse @loc{Tomb of Giants} and defeat @enemy{Gravelord Nito} for his Lord Soul.

guide.context: Join Gravelord Servant and obtain Gravelord Greatsword Dance before this fight; Nito's death closes both covenant actions for the cycle.

steps.text: Place the @item{Lordvessel} at @loc{Firelink Altar} to remove the golden fog gate.
Descend through @loc{The Catacombs} and @loc{Tomb of Giants} to Nito's fog gate.
Enter the chamber and defeat @enemy{Gravelord Nito}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Soul Lord Bed of Chaos.
achievements.summary: After placing the @item{Lordvessel}, traverse @loc{Lost Izalith} and destroy both side roots plus the central core of the @enemy{Bed of Chaos}.

guide.context: Make Quelana appear, buy her inventory, and accept her request before this boss dies; returning afterward supplies the missable Fire Tempest pyromancy.

steps.text: Place the @item{Lordvessel} at @loc{Firelink Altar} to remove the golden fog gate.
Reach @loc{Lost Izalith}, enter the boss arena, and destroy the glowing root on each side.
Return to the center, break through the floor and branches, and kill the small central core of the @enemy{Bed of Chaos}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Four Kings, inheritors of souls.
achievements.summary: Drain @loc{New Londo Ruins}, equip the @item{Covenant of Artorias}, drop into the Abyss, and defeat the @enemy{Four Kings}.

guide.context: For the Darkwraith route, complete this fight before placing the Lordvessel through Frampt so Darkstalker Kaathe appears at the Abyss bonfire.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Great Grey Wolf Sif} and equip the @item{Covenant of Artorias}.
Obtain the @item{Key to the Seal} from @npc{Ingward}, open the floodgate, and drain @loc{New Londo Ruins}.
Keep the ring equipped, drop into the Abyss beyond the fog gate, and defeat the @enemy{Four Kings}.

achievements.description: Defeat Seath the Scaleless, inheritors of souls.
achievements.summary: Escape the @loc{Duke's Archives} prison, cross @loc{Crystal Cave}, destroy the @item{Primordial Crystal}, and defeat @enemy{Seath the Scaleless}.

guide.context: Seath cannot be damaged until the crystal behind him is broken; cut the tip of his rear tail before the kill to secure Moonlight Greatsword.

steps.text: After the scripted defeat in Seath's study, escape the prison tower and clear the archives libraries.
Cross @loc{Crystal Cave}, enter Seath's arena, and destroy the @item{Primordial Crystal} at the rear.
Defeat @enemy{Seath the Scaleless} after obtaining the tail-cut weapon.

achievements.description: Defeat Dark Sun Gwyndolin, the Darkmoon God.
achievements.summary: Reveal the stairs at @loc{Darkmoon Tomb} with the @item{Darkmoon Seance Ring}, enter the fog gate, and defeat @enemy{Dark Sun Gwyndolin}.

guide.context: Entering the fog gate betrays Blade of the Darkmoon; first offer 10 Souvenirs of Reprisal for Darkmoon Blade, then loot Sunlight Blade beyond the cleared arena.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Darkmoon Seance Ring} at @loc{Darkmoon Tomb} and descend after Gwyn's statue vanishes.
Join @mechanic{Blade of the Darkmoon} and obtain @item{Darkmoon Blade} before crossing the fog gate.
Enter the fog gate and defeat @enemy{Dark Sun Gwyndolin}.

achievements.summary: Carry the @item{Peculiar Doll} to Anor Londo's huge painting, clear @loc{Painted World of Ariamis}, attack @enemy{Crossbreed Priscilla}, and defeat her.

guide.context: The painting traps the character until the area exit is reached. Cut Priscilla's small tail before the kill for a Knight's Honor weapon.

steps.text: Return to the starting cell in @loc{Northern Undead Asylum} and collect the @item{Peculiar Doll}.
At the Anor Londo painting cathedral, examine the huge painting while carrying the doll.
Reach the far bridge, cut @enemy{Crossbreed Priscilla}'s tail, then attack and defeat her.
